title: Chapter 6979: Too Late

Chapter 6979: Too Late

Chapter 6979: Too Late

“I feel like coming closer.” Li Qiye smiled and walked closer.

“That’s it!” The tile attacked but its target was Survivor Realm, not Li Qiye.

It didn’t have a mouth but somehow spewed out colorful bubbles. They belonged in a child’s beautiful dream world.

However, they brought havoc through explosions. Li Qiye couldn’t possibly stop all of them. Just one would end Survivor Realm.

“No!” Tribulation Daoist shouted.

Meanwhile, the tile ran away, hoping the bubbles would buy enough time.

“Buzz.” Time froze entirely in Survivor Realm.

A cultivator could perform a seal but it shouldn’t have affected an immortal-level being. Nonetheless, it couldn’t move at all. The same applied to the daoist and the emperors.

Li Qiye smiled and blew hard, popping all the bubbles without activating the explosions.

“Pop!” Once they were gone, time flowed normally again.

The tile was horrified since this was its best move, capable of unleashing havoc on a vast battlefield. It knew just how hard it was to block the bubbles, let alone nullify them entirely.

“You...” The tile was speechless.

“I have to do it my way since you don’t want to talk.” Li Qiye smiled.

“No, no, I’ll talk, I’ll talk.” The tile begged.

“It’s too late now.” Li Qiye shook his head and touched the tile.

“Crack!” Cracks appeared and immortal rays oozed out.

“Spare me!” It feared death the most and begged for mercy.

This fell upon deaf ears since Li Qiye crushed it, allowing immortal rays to break free. He contained it within his fist, preventing unnecessary destruction.

He froze its mind, preventing any self-implosion. Immortals could self-destruct to prevent anyone from peering into their memories.

Unfortunately, this was useless. Li Qiye’s method was simple yet effective. Once extracted, the target’s memories became clear to Li Qiye.

Li Qiye took his time scanning before frowning: “I see, there is this relationship. Heavenfall’s origin is interesting.”

At the same time, the Tribulation Daoist and the other emperors were terrified.

They previously thought immortals were supreme existences - the peak of this universe. After all, their realm only had one.

Now, an immortal couldn’t block one move from Li Qiye, having its memories extracted. It became clear that the guy could breathe and destroy their Survivor Realm.
